conditions.name: Amebiasis

ratingSchedule.note: Current infectious/parasitic rating framework. DC 6320 covers parasitic diseases otherwise not specified; former digestive DC 7321 was removed effective May 19, 2024.

reviewNotes: Do not assign historical DC 7321. VA removed that digestive diagnostic code effective May 19, 2024; use the current infectious/parasitic framework and rate documented residual disability within the appropriate body system.
Rating identity does not establish service connection or medical nexus.

conditions.name: Actinomycosis

ratingSchedule.note: DC 6822 under Bacterial Infections of the Lung; active pulmonary infection is evaluated under that formula and respiratory residuals are rated according to documented findings.

reviewNotes: DC 6822 is a respiratory/pulmonary rating identity. Extra-pulmonary actinomycosis may require evaluation under the body-system criteria for the documented residuals.
Do not use the rating schedule as evidence of causation or secondary nexus.

conditions.name: Nocardiosis

ratingSchedule.note: DC 6823 under Bacterial Infections of the Lung; active pulmonary infection is evaluated under that formula and respiratory residuals are rated according to documented findings.

reviewNotes: DC 6823 is a respiratory/pulmonary rating identity. Extra-pulmonary nocardiosis may require evaluation under the body-system criteria for the documented residuals.
Do not use the rating schedule as evidence of causation or secondary nexus.

conditions.name: Histoplasmosis of Lung

ratingSchedule.note: DC 6834, Histoplasmosis of lung, under the General Rating Formula for Mycotic Lung Disease.

reviewNotes: The approved stable id is histoplasmosis, but the Part 4 diagnostic-code identity is specifically pulmonary histoplasmosis/histoplasmosis of lung. Do not imply DC 6834 governs every extra-pulmonary manifestation.
Clinical relationship authoring must separately evaluate documented disease site and residuals.

conditions.name: Strongyloidiasis

ratingSchedule.note: DC 6325 expressly covers hyperinfection syndrome or disseminated strongyloidiasis. Other parasitic presentations may require DC 6320 or rating of residual disability in the appropriate body system.

reviewNotes: Do not treat DC 6325 as a diagnosis-specific code for every uncomplicated or localized Strongyloides infection; its express scope is hyperinfection syndrome or disseminated strongyloidiasis.
The broader stable catalog identity is retained for discovery while coding scope remains explicit.

conditions.name: Rickettsial, Ehrlichia, and Anaplasma Infections

ratingSchedule.note: DC 6317 expressly covers rickettsial, ehrlichia, and anaplasma infections, including examples such as scrub typhus, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, ehrlichiosis, and anaplasmosis.

reviewNotes: This grouped identity follows the current DC 6317 regulatory grouping. Shared rating identity does not imply that all included infections share one etiology, course, residual pattern, or secondary pathway.
